title: Composition comparison for standing exceptional inverse images
statement:
Assume the canonical compact-support composition isomorphism of [thm-sf-comp-composition]. Fix the finite-coefficient conventions of [def-pur-conventions], including the algebraically closed field $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$, and write $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. For composable separated finite-type morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ of finite-type $k$-schemes, and $L\in D^b_c(S,A)$, let

$$
c_{g,f,L}:R(gf)^!_A L\longrightarrow Rf^!_A Rg^!_A L
$$

be the morphism corresponding, under the composite hom bijection
$$
\operatorname{Hom}_S(Rg_{!,A}Rf_{!,A}K,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_Y(Rf_{!,A}K,Rg^!_AL)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_X(K,Rf^!_ARg^!_AL),\qquad K=R(gf)^!_AL,
$$
of the composite adjunction $Rg_{!,A}Rf_{!,A}\dashv Rf^!_A Rg^!_A$ [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], to the composite

$$
Rg_{!,A}Rf_{!,A}R(gf)^!_A L
\xrightarrow{\alpha_{g,f}}R(gf)_{!,A}R(gf)^!_A L
\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{gf,L}}L.
$$

Here $Rf_!,Rg_!,R(gf)_!$ are the compact-support direct images of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and $Rf^!,Rg^!,R(gf)^!$ are the constructible exceptional inverse images of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], the standing ones of [def-pur-conventions]; they carry $D^b_c(S,A)$ into $D^b_c(Y,A)$ and $D^b_c(X,A)$. The adjunction bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(Rh_!K',L')\cong\operatorname{Hom}(K',Rh^!L')$ used above, for bounded-below $K'$ of etale origin and bounded-below $L'$, are those of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], and $\varepsilon_{gf}$ is the counit of this standing adjunction for $gf$. The object $K=R(gf)^!_AL\in D^b_c(X,A)$ has an etale-origin witness by [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin](ii), so $\alpha_{g,f}$ is evaluated on its stated domain, and $Rf_{!,A}K$ is again bounded below of etale origin by [thm-sf-comp-composition]. The object $L$ and all displayed functors are on the small pro-etale sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].

split_report.summary: Audited the imported definition against the main-20261015 blueprint and the current DAG. No Lean declaration states the item. The three stale pur9 references were made precise with existing nodes: thm-sf-comp-composition supplies the compact-support comparison, def-pur-conventions supplies the finite-coefficient standing choices and adjunction, and def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, pur713-def-upper-shriek and def-weil-pbc-proetale-site supply the displayed composite adjunction, functors and categories. No new nodes were needed; the defining morphism and its counit formula are unchanged. Maintainer-reader repair (2026-10-17): the exceptional functors are those of def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image fixed by def-pur-conventions (whose counit the definition uses), not pur713-def-upper-shriek, which needs an unrestricted pro-etale proper adjoint that def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image shows does not exist in general. L is restricted to D^b_c(S,A), where the standing adjunction (thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class) and alpha_{g,f} (etale-origin domain, lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin(ii)) are defined. This is the reading the merged citer thm-pur-composition-coherence already uses.

lean.note: The helper constructs the normalized Hom equivalence from fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso, the derived comparison adjunction, the ordinary etale adjunction and fully faithful comparison pullback. The main definition applies the composite of these equivalences to the specified originCompositionAmbient followed by the standing counit. sfFiniteExceptionalAt at the chosen compactification supplies K; its formula is definitionally the existing rightDerivedUpperShriek. No additional adjunction, preservation or origin hypotheses are supplied by the caller.
